facts: One replacement MFA-backed session was established in ATTEMPT-004.
No IAM or infrastructure mutations occurred.
The failure occurred during the pre-mutation bootstrap simulation gate.
Invoke-AwsJson redirects AWS CLI stderr to null and replaces every nonzero exit with a synthesized AWS_CALL_FAILED service-operation code.
The bootstrap simulation loop catches every exception and replaces it with BOOTSTRAP_SIMULATION_UNAVAILABLE_OR_DENIED.

root_cause_verdict.reconciled_interpretation: The exact AWS-side cause is not recoverable from the recorded evidence because the script suppresses stderr and collapses all simulation failures into one generic code.

candidate_causes.basis: All exceptions in the simulation loop are replaced by one generic failure code.
AccessDenied is plausible but stderr and AWS error metadata were discarded.
Context entry, action or resource validation errors would be collapsed identically.
The IAM user ARN passed STS shape validation, but AWS response details are absent.
No preserved AWS error proves or excludes this cause.
The static repository does not contain current Organizations/SCP state.
CLI parsing, invocation and environment failures share the same collapsed path.

required_resolution: A separately authorized read-only diagnostic must preserve sanitized AWS CLI exit code, error type, request identifier suffix or hash, operation, action under test and input-validation category before mapping to a governed failure code.
